Why Donate

The Gift of Life

Blood donation is one of the most selfless acts of kindness. One donation can save up to three lives.

Save Lives

One unit of blood can save up to three lives in emergency situations.

Quick Process

The entire donation process takes only 10-15 minutes of your time.

Safe & Healthy

Blood donation is safe. Your body replenishes the donated blood quickly.

Community

Join a growing community of heroes at Premier University Chittagong.
